proceedings.supporting_quote: On 5 April 1995 at about 8.30 p.m. the applicant, driving a car, was arrested in Slovenj Gradec by officers of the Special Unit and the Slovenj Gradec Police.
On 7 April 1995 the applicant went to the Slovenj Gradec Police and made an oral complaint against the officers of the Special Unit

proceedings.deciding_body: Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office
proceedings.supporting_quote: the applicant lodged, through his lawyer, a written criminal complaint
the Slovenj Gradec District Court decided not to open a criminal investigation against the applicant

proceedings.supporting_quote: By a judgment of 22 November 1999 the court acquitted the applicant

proceedings.supporting_quote: The judgment of 12 February 2001 issued in the proceedings instituted against the applicant
